diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~120% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. A few outliers stand out (10 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.524), which favours a selective combination.
